title: fix(keys): preserve untouched expiry when editing
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
- Prevents rename or permission-only saves from extending an untouched key expiry.
- Captures the initial expiry selection once; sends expiresAt only when the selection changes.
- Adds four component regressions; parent rerun: 32 related tests pass. Eight local React renderer controls cover explicit edits, clearing and elapsed-day rerenders.
- Biome passes. Full service typecheck remains blocked by identical baseline dependency/generated-binding diagnostics; full Worker suite was not run locally.

Fixes #16382

gist.headline: A rename is not a renewal
gist.blurb: Giving an API key a new name should not give it a new expiry date. The edit dialog leaves the clock alone unless you actually change it.
gist.summary: Editing an API key's name or permissions preserves its existing expiry by sending expiresAt only when the expiry selection changes.
gist.impact: Users can rename a key or adjust its permissions without unintentionally extending its expiration; explicit expiry edits still apply.
gist.visual_concept: Polli edits the label on a pixel-art API key while a small calendar beside it stays on the same date. A potted code-plant and a cozy terminal make the key-management setting clear.
